final_full_data_method_freeze.full_data_refit: Use the frozen method family, simulation-selected neural profile, primary feature budget, and all 78 cases without outcomes.
final_full_data_method_freeze.primary_rule: Choose the model_id selected most frequently by inner-CV one-SE selection across all outer splits.
final_full_data_method_freeze.tie_breaker: Lower complexity_rank, then lexicographically smaller model_id.
final_full_data_method_freeze.uncertainty_rule: If no model reaches 40% selection frequency, do not claim a unique winner. Freeze the two most frequently selected non-failed methods as co-primary representations and report method uncertainty.

simulation_profile_selection.selection_rule: Among eligible profiles, choose the lowest-complexity profile within one standard error of the highest mean simulation utility.

component_formulas.modality_balance_score: normalized entropy of view contribution energy

target_nested_selection.neural_early_stopping_rule: Each inner model-selection split has a deterministic fit, early-stop, and validation partition. The validation partition is never used for early stopping. After selecting an epoch on the early-stop subset, refit on fit plus early-stop samples for that fixed epoch before scoring the inner validation subset.
target_nested_selection.one_standard_error_rule: Choose the lowest-complexity eligible model whose mean inner-CV utility is at least best_mean - standard_error_of_best.
target_nested_selection.outer_test_evaluation: Each outer-training split has a deterministic fit and early-stop partition. Select the epoch without outer-test access, refit on all outer-training samples for that fixed epoch, then evaluate once on the untouched outer test fold.
target_nested_selection.tie_breaker: Lower complexity_rank, then lexicographically smaller model_id.
